S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.title: Getter Mandala
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.INITIAL.descr: For an instant, you glimpse [sine][getter_ray]countless Getter evolutions[/getter_ray][/sine] beyond the distant void. Your hand reaches toward...
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.INITIAL.optio: A Getter battleship blotting out the sun...
The fusion of countless Getter Gs...
Choose up to 3 Attack cards to enchant with [gold]Devolution[/gold].
Choose up to 3 cards to enchant with [gold]Adaptation[/gold].
A being greater than Shin Dragon...
Obtain Saint Dragon Roar enchanted with [gold]Corrupted[/gold].
A Getter as mighty as a guardian god...
Upgrade all cards in your deck whose names contain Getter.
Heal 30 HP and add an [gold]Insect-Human Virus[/gold] to your deck.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.SOLAR_BATTLES: Somewhere deep in fate, [gold][b]guidance from a future Getter[/b][/gold] reaches you. You see the endpoint of evolution.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.GETTER_G_FUSI: You feel Shin Getter drawing the power of [red]Getter One[/red], [white]Getter Two[/white], and [yellow]Getter Three[/yellow] into one.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.PRIMAL_GETTER: [getter_ray][b]Getter[/b][/getter_ray] is both the beginning and the end.
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.FIRST_EVOLUTI: Getter G... Musashi never lived to see its birth.
[purple][sine]The aura is terrifying[/sine][/purple]. You cannot tell whether wielding the Saint Dragon's power is right.
For a moment, the Getter in your vision merges with Shin Getter. Is this... [gold][sine]Heaven?[/sine][/gold]
S_G_E_GETTER_MANDALA.pages.IGNORE.descri: Invaded by BUGS, you reject [getter_ray]Getter's[/getter_ray] will.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TEA_MASTER.pa: Ryoma: [red]Tea ceremony? Take my punch first![/red]
Requires more than 5 HP and Fighting Spirit or Spirit.
Pay [red]100[/red] Gold. Choose [gold]Bone Tea[/gold] or [gold]Ember Tea[/gold].

Ryoma never touches the cup. He suddenly punches across the tea table. The master catches it steadily on a tray. Cushions fly in the gust, but not a drop of tea spills.

Recoil travels up his arm into his chest. Ryoma steps back, then bursts out laughing. The master takes no offense, simply sliding the cup with its dark-red embers toward him.

「Not bad! Now that's a proper cup!」

Ryoma means to throw another punch, but Benkei gently pushes him aside and rolls up his sleeves at the tea table. Those broad palms, strong enough for Getter's controls, now guide a steady stream: warming the cups, measuring leaves, pouring, and serving, each step remarkably quiet.

The tea's aroma slowly overcomes the scorched smell. For the first time the master sets aside his scrutiny, carefully finishes Benkei's tea, and places Bone Tea and Ember Tea before him.

Benkei rubs his nose, a little embarrassed.

「Picked up a little looking after the kids. Even a rough fellow shouldn't waste good tea.」
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SLIPPERY_BRID: Ryoma: [red]You think a rotten bridge can stop me?[/red]
Requires more than 5 HP and Spirit, Drive, or Super Spirit.
Hayato: [white]It will collapse. Discard exactly what we do not need.[/white]
Choose 1 card to remove. Lose no HP.
Requires a removable card and Accel or Shed Load.

Ryoma takes Getter One onto the bridge through the downpour. The first plank snaps beneath its foot, driving a shock through the controls into the cockpit. He never looks back. Through collapsing boards he carries the machine to the far bank; splinters scrape the armor and stones strike the canopy, but nothing is left behind.

[red]「Throw something away just to cross? Don't make me laugh!」[/red]

A glance at the current, wind, and bending planks tells Hayato the only safe sequence of steps. Before crossing, he has Getter Two unload its external spares and ballast on the bank, lightening the bridge's burden.

With the parts unloaded, he reviews the tactical records inside the cockpit and strikes out the one he won't carry across.

Getter Two flashes over the bridge's surviving skeleton.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SPIRIT_GRAFTE: Requires an exclusive card for Getter 1, Getter 2, and Getter 3 in the deck.

Ashen roots reach for three hearts. The men allow contact. As the roots touch, Ryoma resists the first intrusion; Hayato follows the pulse to the segment it came through. Benkei says nothing. When the recoil pours in, he only grits his teeth.

Three heartbeats become one. [getter_ray][sine]Blue-green light[/sine][/getter_ray] floods back along the roots, loosening them one by one. The intrusion is driven out. The grafter cannot take command of Shin Getter, but a new structure remains within it.

[red]「What you touched was[/red][white] our souls.[/white][yellow] Now it gets to adapt to us.」[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WOOD_CARVINGS: Triple Unity: [red]A soaring bird[/red], [white]a cunning snake[/white], [yellow]a steadfast ring[/yellow]... That's [getter_ray]Getter[/getter_ray]!
Obtain [gold]Triple Wood Carving[/gold]. At the start of combat, [gold]Transform[/gold] 1 to 3 times at random.

Ryoma takes three carvings from the shelf. He gives the snake to Hayato and places the ring in Benkei's open palm, keeping the bird himself.

Hayato traces the snake's grooves: each turn avoids the hardest grain. A silver-white line glints across it. Satisfied, he sets it beside Benkei.

A fine crack runs along the ring's edge. Benkei supports it in his palm, slowly joining the break until yellow light appears within. Ryoma looks at those hands and offers the bird. [red]「Like you. Rough as they come.」[/red]

[yellow]「And just as sturdy.」[/yellow] Benkei takes it with his free hand and places it on the joined ring. A red line flashes along its wingtip. The carvings rest together; red, white, and yellow glimmer in turn, then become one.
Hayato: [white]There are more than two choices. Here is the payment slot.[/white]
Pay [red]75[/red] Gold. Obtain a random Relic.
Requires 75 Gold and Foresight or Backup Plan.

The two buttons flash in turn, urging a choice. Ryoma watches, then punches straight between them. Gears, springs, and an iron plate marked 「Choice」 scatter across the floor. The machine finally falls silent.

He takes nothing, simply stepping over the wreckage and moving on.

「You don't get to decide my answer.」

Hayato's fingers trace the back of the device, finding a nearly invisible coin slot under the grease. As the coins fall, both competing buttons go dark. A hidden compartment at the side springs open with a relic.

[white]「One or the other is merely the question it wanted you to see.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.AMALGAMATOR.p: Ryoma: [red]This junk? Take all of it![/red]
Remove all [gold]Strikes[/gold] and [gold]Defends[/gold], then remove 1 additional card.
Requires at least 1 removable card that is neither Strike nor Defend.
Benkei: [yellow]Wait. Let me sort this out.[/yellow]
Pay [red]100[/red] Gold. Remove 2 [gold]Strikes[/gold] and 2 [gold]Defends[/gold]. Obtain [gold]Ultimate Strike[/gold] and [gold]Ultimate Defend[/gold].
Requires 100 Gold, 2 removable Strikes, and 2 removable Defends.

[b][jitter]CLANG! CLANG!!![/jitter][/b]

The [orange]Amalgamator[/orange]'s great hammer strikes the bone anvil.

Ryoma names every old technique he means to discard in one breath. With each hammer blow, moves are crossed out of the combat records. Sparks scatter at his feet.

[red]「Take the lot. Don't give that last move back either.」[/red]

[b][jitter]CLANG! CLANG!!![/jitter][/b]

The Amalgamator raises its great hammer.

Benkei puts a hand on the bone anvil. 「Wait.」 He counts out the coins and pushes them over before handing over the old offensive and defensive tactical records.

The Amalgamator says nothing and bends to work.

When the hammer falls silent, the records contain a fiercer attack and a steadier defense. Benkei checks that both are usable, then packs away the remaining parts.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.BYRDONIS_NEST: Benkei: [yellow]Push the eggs back. I will hold the nest.[/yellow]
Ryoma: [red]The nest is here. It will come back.[/red]
Add [gold]{Card}[/gold] to your Deck and fight Byrdonis. Hatch it early after winning.
Requires Valor, Fighting Spirit, or Super Spirit.

As the nest floor splits, Benkei Kuruma has Getter Three braced against the broken branches, with Ryoma and Hayato in the cockpit behind him. Its forearms catch the rolling eggs one by one and return them to the nest.

The weight of the supporting branches presses entirely onto Getter Three's shoulder armor, denting the metal. Benkei grits his teeth and holds. Only when the last branch is back in place does he look up at the sky.

[yellow]「All right. Time to move.」[/yellow]

Ryoma stoops to lift an egg and carries it into the cockpit before combination, securing it in a cushioned compartment. Benkei steadies it at the hatch while Hayato glances at the winged shadows circling above.

[white]「It'll look for the egg when it returns. We wait here.」[/white]

[yellow]「It's after the egg. Keep it from crashing into the cockpit.」[/yellow]

Ryoma fastens each latch of the compartment and looks toward the shadow beyond the cliff.

[red]「Right on time. Plenty of room here. [jitter]CHANGE GETTER ONE![/jitter]」[/red]

The roar of combination rolls between the cliffs. Shin Getter stands before the nest. The egg remains secure in its cushioned compartment.

The Byrdonis falls into the rocks outside the nest. Residual [getter_ray]Getter Rays[/getter_ray] still drift between the cliffs. Inside the cockpit, the egg gives a faint tremor, then develops a hairline crack.

Hayato presses a hand to the console, watching its shifting readings.

[white]「It absorbed the [getter_ray]Getter Rays[/getter_ray] left by the battle...? The hatching's accelerated.」[/white]

Benkei has already placed his palm beneath the hatch, his voice gentler now.

[yellow]「Easy. It hasn't found its feet yet.」[/yellow]

The shell breaks. A baby bird peeks out. Ryoma watches it shake fragments from its wings, then lifts it from the compartment.

None of them speaks at once. Only the chick's tiny wingbeats fill the cockpit.

[red]「Then come with us, little one.」[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.INFESTED_AUTO: Hayato: [white]The parasite and core pulse differently. Cut along this line.[/white]
Lose [red]4[/red] Max HP. Choose 1 card from 2 Powers and 2 zero-cost cards.
Requires more than 4 Max HP and Jammer or Foresight.

Hayato leaves the exposed core untouched. He sends a scan against the abnormal pulse, marking every parasitic filament in his field of view.

[white]「The pulses don't match. It can't hide any longer.」[/white]

Getter Two cuts in along the markers. The filaments snap and writhe as the mechanical core lights again; a sharp neural feedback shoots through the controls into the cockpit. Pressing a hand to his temple, Hayato intercepts a complete technical record before the core finishes its self-check.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.THE_LEGENDS_W: Ryoma: [red]A scrap of paper wants to lead me? Tear it up.[/red]
Abandon the treasure map. Obtain [gold]Good Citizen Card[/gold].
You already have Good Citizen Card.
Requires 35 Gold and Getter Claw, Spiral Drill, or Tornado Drill.

Ryoma holds the treasure map to the fire, studies it for two seconds, then tears it apart. A smoke-stained card slips from between its layers. He holds it by one corner.

[red]「A good citizen would never fall for a trick this childish.」[/red]

Hayato reads the card and starts laughing. [white]「You...」[/white]

Benkei leans closer, eyes wide. [yellow]「You actually kept that?」[/yellow]

[red]「Quiet, both of you old men.」[/red]

Hayato crouches before the mural and traces its old fractures. One echo returns half a beat early, revealing the exit.

Getter 2 slips through the narrow passage as stone edges rake sparks from its shell. A refrigerated canister still runs at the end. Coins drop into its calibration slot and the lock springs open.

Hayato studies the green spiral beneath the cap.

[white]「Unexpected profit. We even get a drink.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TRIAL.pages.I: Challenge the three elite Knights. Gain buffs at combat start.
Requires Spirit, Drive, Super Spirit, Fighting Spirit, or Persist.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TRIAL.pages.R:
The case has been read.

Ryoma first looks at the accused on the platform.

[red]「You're guilty. Of cowardice.」[/red]

Angry voices erupt from the court. Getter One stands in the space between jury and platform—the hall is tall enough for a machine. In the cockpit, the controls creak in Ryoma's grip. He turns the machine to face the jury.

[red]「You've judged cases like this too many times. But the ones who should be condemned are you sitting there judging them.」[/red]

The gavel falls. Chains and shadows leap together. Shin Getter charges into them and out of the court; battle begins.
Challenge the Flail Knight, Spectral Knight, and Magi Knight.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SUNKEN_STATUE: Benkei: [yellow]Water? This is where Getter 3 shines![/yellow]
Lose [red]7[/red] Max HP. Gain more Gold.
Requires more than 7 HP and Persist or Wall.

Getter 3 [jitter]descends[/jitter] along the statue's ruined shoulder. Each layer of pressure tightens around its armor and deepens the warning alarms.

[yellow]「Just a little longer. I have almost found them all.」[/yellow]

Benkei does not stop at the first glint. He shields the recovery bay and searches the bottom until even the last coin buried in silt is aboard, then drags the damaged armor back to the surface.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SPIRALING_WHI: Hayato: [white]Unmake one completed record and reverse-engineer its structure.[/white]
Choose 1 upgraded card to downgrade. Enchant every unenchanted Drill card with [gold]Spiral[/gold].
Requires Tornado Drill or Spiral Drill and at least 1 upgraded card.

Hayato slowly spins Getter Two's drill in reverse. Two [sine][aqua]spirals[/aqua][/sine] mesh, breaking the unreadable water into layers of clear [sine][aqua]trajectories[/aqua][/sine].

An enhanced combat record unravels under the reverse calculation, returning to its [u]unupgraded[/u] state. Hayato writes the extracted principles into the Tornado Drill and Spiral Drill records able to accept them. Next activation, the drills will replay along that same [sine][aqua]trajectory[/aqua][/sine].
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ROUND_TEA_PAR: Ryoma: [red]If the tea is poisoned, say so. If you want a fight, I will give you one![/red]
Take [red]11[/red] unblocked damage. Upgrade 1 Spirit or Fighting Spirit. Obtain a random Relic.
Requires more than 11 HP and an unupgraded Spirit or Fighting Spirit.

Ryoma lifts the cup, smells it, and turns it back onto the table.

[red]「You put something in the tea and still act so polite.」[/red]

He flips the round table forward. Through the gap, Hayato sees the chairs to the side move first and tells him to duck. Benkei catches a piece of tabletop to shield them from pursuers behind.

Ryoma takes a full collision, lowers his body with it, and changes the angle of his punch. Without breaking his drive, he tears a path out of the circle.

When the others retreat, he finds a relic beneath the wrecked table and wipes the blood from his mouth. [red][jitter]「Now that's hospitality.」[/jitter][/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.RANWID_THE_EL: Ryoma: [red]Want to study Getter? Trade me something from your collection first.[/red]
Remove 1 [gold]Saotome Blueprint[/gold]. Choose 1 of 2 random Relics to obtain.

Ranwid hasn't looked away since seeing Getter. He circles halfway around the machine, tracing its combination joints in the air and muttering. Ryoma knows that absorbed expression. The old man wore it over unfinished machines; he'd seen it countless times at the Saotome Institute.

「Want to study Getter? Bring out your collection first.」 Ryoma lays down the terms.

Hayato unfolds a corner of the blueprint. Ranwid immediately leans over it, riveted by combination structures that contradict one another yet all work.

[red]「The complete plans for one piece from your collection. I choose.」[/red] Ryoma makes no concession. [red]「You really do look like that old man.」[/red]
View the 2 Relics offered by Ranwid.
After a long silence, the elder sets out two relics. Ryoma takes one and pushes the complete blueprint over. Before Ranwid looks up, the three men are already moving on.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WELCOME_TO_WO: Your abusive purchase in [gold]{Act}[/gold] prevents this transaction.
Customer Credentials: [white]If it remembers the free purchase, make it remember this card too.[/white]
Present the [gold]Good Citizen Card[/gold] and leave normally.
Requires the Good Citizen Card and a previous free shop purchase.

The scanner swallows the card. Price tags go dark one after another. The screen displays several zero-amount bills, then settles on 「Customer verification complete.」

A line lights up over the gate: [red]「Malicious spending detected. This transaction has been frozen.」[/red]

Ryoma stares at the bills. [red]「Taking it free still counts as spending?」[/red]

[white]「In its accounts, at least.」[/white] Hayato retrieves the card and indicates the exit. Benkei looks at the darkened shelves. [yellow]「Let's leave arguing with the store for another day.」[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TRASH_HEAP.pa: Benkei: [yellow]Don't dig blindly. I'll hold it up; you find one thing that still works.[/yellow]
Lose [red]12[/red] HP. Choose 1 of 3 relics from the old collection.
Requires more than 12 HP and Indomitable, Iron Wall, or Guts.

As a gap opens in the rubbish mountain, a whole sheet of rusted components collapses. Benkei does not retreat. Getter Three sinks into the sludge, holding the falling weight overhead with both arms.

[yellow]「Make it quick, you two.」[/yellow]

Three old objects that still respond roll from the gap. Only after one is chosen does Benkei ease his grip, letting the heap thunder shut behind them.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TINKER_TIME.p: Research Route: [white]The tolerances are wrong. Recalibrate it to Professor Saotome's blueprint.[/white]
Pay [red]50[/red] Gold to reroll the 2 displayed card types.
Requires 50 Gold, a Research or Evolution card, and no prior reroll in this event.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.REFLECTIONS.p: Triple Unity: [red]Don't rush it.[/red] [white]One at a time.[/white] [yellow]I'll hold both sides steady.[/yellow]
Lose [red]5[/red] Max HP. Choose 1 non-Rare, non-Special card to duplicate.
Requires Triple Unity, a valid card to copy, and more than 5 Max HP.
Choose 1 non-Curse, non-Status, non-Rare, non-Special card to duplicate.

The mirror stands before the three men. Their reflections raise their hands half a beat early, each landing just off its mark. The first misaligned fist faces Ryoma. He meets it and forces its path back where it belongs.

Hayato watches the mirror and calls out that missing half-beat. Ryoma shifts his hand a fraction. Benkei sinks his weight into his feet; when the mirror shakes, he holds first.

The three reflections overlap. Red, silver-white, and yellow flash only at that instant, leaving a combat record identical to the one outside. A fine crack appears at the edge. All three stagger together, as if half a breath has been drawn out of them.

[red]「Another shadow doesn't matter. Not one of us is changing places.」[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.DOORS_OF_LIGH: Ryoma: [red]Light, dark—it doesn't matter. Wall, get out of my way![/red]
Lose [red]6[/red] HP. Choose 1 card to Transform into a random Colorless card.
Requires more than 6 HP, a Spirit Drive card, and a Transformable card.
Choose 1 card to Transform into a random Colorless card.

The corridor is too narrow for the machine. Ryoma leaves Shin Getter outside and stands between the doors himself.

Both doors urge him on. He fixes his eyes on the wall with no handle.

Before Hayato finishes explaining the mechanism, Ryoma charges and punches it. Stone splits down the middle. Light and darkness pour through the crack; recoil drives from his knuckles into his forearm. Both currents scrape his side. He stumbles half a step into the doorframe. The nearest combat record tears apart, leaving a colorless outline.

[red][jitter]「Doors are for people who play by the rules.」[/jitter][/red] He braces his other hand on the wall and shakes the stone dust from his fingers.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WELLSPRING.pa: Getter Ray Route: [getter_ray]Let the spring remember Evolution, then let Getter Rays bring it back.[/getter_ray]
Lose [red]3[/red] Max HP. Add 1 [gold]Evolution Resonance[/gold] to your deck.
Requires more than 3 Max HP and a Getter Ray card.

Blue-green light sinks into the spring, yet its ripples return to the bank in time with the Getter Rays.

Ryoma narrows the beam, retaining the strange resonance in the circuits. Water surges back along it, biting away a corner of armor. Hayato waits until the surface dims, then saves the waveform in a tactical record.

[white]「We've kept the resonance.」[/white] He steadies the still-trembling gauge. [white]「The price is the same. This isn't a gift.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ROOM_FULL_OF_: Benkei: [yellow]Don't eat yet. I'll sort out the pieces that aren't food.[/yellow]
Lose [red]7[/red] HP. Choose 2 of 10 Common cards and Upgrade them.
Requires more than 7 HP and Guts or Indomitable.
Choose 2 safe Common cards to add to your deck.

Benkei breaks off a small piece from each cheese. The first is too salty, the second bitter, and the third jumps on his tongue.

His face grows worse, but he neatly sets the safe pieces before everyone. As someone reaches out, Hayato warns them: [white]「Benkei hasn't tried that one yet.」[/white]

Ryoma eyes the empty row and laughs mercilessly. [red]「So there's a reason Getter Three's pilot is that fat.」[/red]

[yellow]「I'm fine. At least these really are edible.」[/yellow] Benkei manages a smile, holding his stomach.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.BUGSLAYER.pag: Benkei: [yellow]Keep arguing about methods. Getter 3 will flatten the swarm in one pass.[/yellow]
Lose [red]5[/red] HP. Upgrade and enchant 1 Getter Rush.
Requires more than 5 HP and an unupgraded, unenchanted Getter Rush.
Choose 1 Getter Rush to Upgrade and enchant with Spiral.

The guide has barely begun explaining that 「there are two methods」 when Benkei lowers Getter 3's stance. Hayato marks a narrow line that will not bring down the cavern roof. Benkei answers only, 「Got it.」

Getter 3 rolls steadily through the mark, spraying shell and slime everywhere as the recoil slams into the cockpit. When the swarm lies flat, the comms finally fall silent.

After a moment, Ryoma bursts out laughing: [red]「Even Benkei cuts loose like that?」[/red]

Hayato pauses. [white]「Please don't ask me to define ‘cutting loose’ for either of you.」[/white]

[yellow]「Take your time naming the method,」[/yellow] Benkei says. [yellow]「Just don't let them crawl out again.」[/yellow]
Emperor's Fragment: [white]The fragment shows more than one possible trade.[/white]
Pay [red]75[/red] Gold. Choose 1 Relic to give up, then choose 1 of 3 Relics of the same rarity.
Requires 75 Gold, Emperor's Fragment, and a tradable Relic with 3 valid replacements.
Choose a Relic to give to the trader.
View 3 replacement Relics of the same rarity.
Emperor's Fragment reveals three possible futures. Choose one.
Pay 75 Gold and complete the trade.
Choose a different Relic to give up.

[sine]A thread of blue-green light seeps from the Emperor's Fragment.[/sine] Before the trader names a price, Ryoma places the chosen old relic on the counter.

Light circles the relic. Three overlapping shadows rise above the counter, each like another path it could have taken. Hayato compares them in turn and points to one. The coins fall into the bag; the other shadows dissolve.

The fragment falls silent, and the counter's light withdraws with it.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ENDLESS_CONVE: Hayato: [white]Take the maintenance record. Leave the current dish alone.[/white]
Requires 20 Gold, a Strategy card, and no prior use in this event.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.UNREST_SITE.p: Ryoma: [red]Perfect, a fire. Let's burn this fighting spirit even hotter![/red]
Choose 1 Spirit to transform into Valor.

As the roots lift, a column of searing flame erupts from the fissure. Ryoma lowers Getter One's shoulder into it.

Fire brushes the armor, but he holds that breath of resolve fast. When he straightens again, Getter One's stance has changed.

Ryoma tightens his grip on the controls. [red]「Now that's training.」[/red]
Lose [red]4[/red] Max HP. Heal 25% of your missing HP and obtain [gold]Pressure Breathing[/gold].
Requires missing HP, more than 4 Max HP, and a Getter 3 defense card.

When the roots press down, Benkei doesn't retreat. He braces Getter Three under their heaviest weight.

Hayato sends a breathing rhythm over the comms. [white]「Inhale for four beats. Hold against it for four.」[/white]

Benkei endures the worst blow in time with the count. When the roots loosen, the machine has sunk further than expected. He doesn't lift it immediately, only repeats the rhythm aloud. [yellow]「Easy to count the beats. Your turn next time.」[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.LOST_WISP.pag: Benkei: [yellow]Don't let it into anyone's heart. I'll contain it first.[/yellow]
Lose [red]5[/red] Max HP. Obtain [gold]Lost Wisp[/gold] without adding Decay.
Requires more than 5 Max HP and a Getter 3 defense card.

Benkei places Getter Three at the front. Its broad armor closes around the drifting wisp until it is trapped in a palm. Hayato reports the erosion readings over the comms. Benkei does not turn.

Cold creeps through the circuits, leaving irreparable ashen scars. Benkei grunts but holds on until the wisp grows quiet.

[yellow]「The wound stays here.」[/yellow] He says, [yellow]「We still walk the road together.」[/yellow]
Hayato: [white]Catch it and it brings something back. Know the route, and you know when to leave.[/white]
Requires more than 3 Max HP and a Strategy card.

As the wisp drifts toward the fork, Hayato stops Getter Two rather than chasing the cold flame.

A silver-white scan traces its incoming path once. Cold pours back through the circuits along that same line. Hayato records the route back as coordinates, releasing the controls only when the chill fades.

[white]「That white suits Getter Two rather well.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.DROWNING_BEAC: Ryoma: [red]Flowing backward? Then I'll throw this water right back at it![/red]
Upgrade 1 random upgradable card with the [getter_ray]Evolution[/getter_ray] role.
Requires an upgradable card with the [getter_ray]Evolution[/getter_ray] role.

Ryoma brings Getter One low across the tower's base, skimming the water and flinging it into the backward-flowing light.

The water does not scatter. It is swept back into the air. Blue-green and cold white collide, as if forcing a sleeping record onto its next page.

Watching the light still flow backward, Ryoma pushes the controls another inch. [red]「So that's another use for it.」[/red]
Benkei: [yellow]Fold the beacon's afterglow into the armor.[/yellow]
Requires more than 9 HP and a Getter 3 defense card.

The tower tilts. Benkei sinks Getter Three to the bottom and braces the wall with its shoulder armor. Hayato calls out the angle of the mirrors over the comms.

Water pressure pounds the armor. A prism far smaller than the topmost lens sits in the inner wall, its socket lit by a beam folded down through the mirrors. Getter Three removes it underwater, cupping it in its mechanical palm before the armor. Once surfaced, Benkei opens the cockpit hatch and takes the prism from that palm. He never looks back at the upper lens.

[yellow]「That isn't the color of Getter Rays.」[/yellow] Benkei says, [yellow]「Still, no sense wasting the lighthouse's last light.」[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.LUMINOUS_CHOI: Ryoma: [red]I'm sick of that singing. Burn away whatever binds them together![/red]
Requires more than 8 HP, a Getter Ray card, and 2 removable cards.

The chorus bears down, and filaments coil around Getter One's armor. Hayato only calls the roots' location over the comms. Ryoma compresses the beam into a dazzling narrow line.

It sweeps the roots, breaking the chorus into countless shattered notes. The filaments snap and peel from the machine. Spores surge back along the light and strike the armor; the recoil burns through the circuits into the cockpit, searing Ryoma's chest.

[red][jitter]「Much quieter.」[/jitter][/red] Ryoma bares his teeth. [red]「Keep it down next time.」[/red]
Hayato: [white]Give the choir one silent beat.[/white]
Lose [red]5[/red] HP. Remove 1 card and obtain [gold]Mycelial Silencer[/gold].
Requires more than 5 HP, a Strategy card, and 1 removable card.

The chorus seeps through cracks in the wall. Filaments emerge and cling to Getter Two's outer armor. Hayato doesn't fire. Using the machine's own hand, he severs them outside the armor and grips a small fragment at the cut.

He reverses the rhythm; the chorus inside the filament misses a beat. Recoil races through the controls into the cockpit. Hayato coughs once.

Once the wall's chorus subsides, Getter Two raises the hand holding the fragment to the hatch and steadies it. Hayato opens the hatch, retrieves the fragment, and seals it in an isolation box.

Ryoma studies the box. [red]「Even that has a use?」[/red]

[white]「When it swallows the noise, it'll stand in front of you.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.COLOSSAL_FLOW: Hayato: [white]The petals close at fixed intervals. Cut in after three seconds.[/white]
Lose [red]2[/red] Max HP. Gain [gold]90[/gold] Gold and leave.
Requires more than 2 Max HP and a Getter 2 speed card.

The petals pause before every contraction. Hayato guides Getter Two into that beat; a silver-white afterimage slips through the corolla.

Scattered coins come out with it, along with a torn piece of armor. Ryoma asks over the comms whether he'll go further. Hayato checks how fast the petals are closing.

[white]「This is far enough.」[/white] He clears the alarm. [white]「Any deeper, and the flower eats the way out first.」[/white]
Ryoma: [red]If once isn't enough, hit it again![/red]
Requires more than 6 HP and a Getter 1 charge card.

Before the petals close, Ryoma has already lowered Getter One into its charge. The full drive of its punch goes into the corolla. Recoil slams through the cockpit, but he forces up a corner of the petals, ripping an opening all the way outside—wide enough to retreat through.

[red][jitter]「If once isn't enough, I'll hit it again.」[/jitter][/red]

Ryoma wipes the blood from his brow. The flower keeps closing, but the tear holds. Getter One backs out while the petals bite together inch by inch behind it.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.THE_FUTURE_OF: Choose and consume 1 Potion to obtain [gold]Luminescent Pulse[/gold].
Requires at least 1 Potion and a Research or Evolution card or Research Notes.

Hayato places the potion on the test bench and checks its wax seal. Ryoma stares at the familiar color. [red]「What are you trading that good stuff for?」[/red]

The liquid passes through the cooling tube little by little. Its old potency breaks down, leaving only a faintly warm glow. Hayato slips the new bottle into the vacated slot.

[white]「Seal it. Don't test it here. I'm not ready to clean up the aftermath.」[/white]

Ryoma snorts. [red]「Then let's not leave it until next time.」[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ABYSSAL_BATHS: Triple Coordination: [red]Don't bring the whole bath back with us.[/red]
Gain 2 Max HP and heal 2 HP. Obtain [gold]Phase Coolant[/gold].

Water begins slipping into the armor seams. Hayato switches the circuit to a cooling branch. Ryoma speaks over the rush: [red]「Don't bring the whole pool back.」[/red]

The armor briefly grows in the heat. Condensation-wreathed liquid follows the branch into a spare collection tank. Hayato holds back the return flow, keeping the pool's force out of the circuit until the gauge reaches zero, then seals the tank.

[white]「This layer is enough. We leave what's underneath alone.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WATERLOGGED_S: Research Route: [white]The water erased the words, but left the order of evolution behind.[/white]
Requires 75 Gold, the Research condition, and a valid Attack, Skill, or Power.

Hayato separates the swollen sheets layer by layer. Their ink has run together, but a few blue-green lines keep growing in the same direction.

He compares them page by page until every stroke fits its proper square. By the time the coins stop falling into the ink pool, the formula is fully copied into a combat record. Ryoma waits impatiently at the door, but Hayato does not hurry the final stroke.

[white]「Only copy what's useful. Leave the rest soaking.」[/white]
Research Route: [white]Seal the surfaced evolution formula in a bottle of ink.[/white]
Requires 45 Gold and a Research or Evolution card or Research Notes.

Water pushes the sheets toward the table's edge. Hayato doesn't fish out the most intact one. He copies every stroke he can still recognize into a small bottle.

Coins sink into the pool. The liquid deepens to green. He seals the bottle and looks up into Ryoma's impatient stare.

[red]「Will that work, Hayato?」[/red]

[white]「It will.」[/white] He hands the bottle over. The dark green settles at the bottom, no longer stirring.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TRANSACTION_E: Event transaction could not be confirmed

An incomplete transaction has been rolled back. If a complete write was confirmed but readback failed, the result remains closed to prevent duplicate costs or rewards. Check save-folder permissions before continuing.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WHISPERING_HO: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「Don't seal it off. Let it pass through me.」[/yellow]
Choose a Relic to lose. Add Triple Whirlwind to your deck.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「Don't seal it off. Let it pass through me.」[/yellow]
[yellow]Benkei:[/yellow] Requires Shin Form, no Triple Whirlwind in the deck, and a removable Relic.

Benkei stops Getter 3 in the hollow's center. Alien echoes press through the Getter rays into its armor; loose parts and Relics hum inside the cockpit.

[yellow]「To carry this wind away, we have to leave something that can hold it down.」[/yellow]

He unfastens the chosen object, opens the hatch, throws it into the echoes, then seals the hatch again. The echo catches it. The wind turns three times, shearing the piled noise into a stable vortex. Silence follows.

Ryoma murmurs, [red]「You can really let it go?」[/red]

[yellow]「No. But unless we leave it, Getter isn't getting out of this hollow.」[/yellow]
Choose a Relic to lose. You may cancel.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SYMBIOTE.page: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「Burn what crosses the line. I'll bear the rest.」[/yellow]
Lose 5 Max HP. Enchant an Attack with Adaptation.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「Burn what crosses the line. I'll bear the rest.」[/yellow]
[yellow]Benkei:[/yellow] Requires more than 5 Max HP and an Attack compatible with Adaptation.

Roots crawl along the armor seams toward the cockpit. Benkei drives Getter 3 forward, pressing the proliferating mass into the sealed zone outside its chest armor.

Ryoma curses over the comms; a short burst of flame scorches the tendrils reaching for the hatch.

[yellow]「It's sealed. Don't ask if it feels good.」[/yellow]
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「Don't let it swallow everything. One sample is enough.」[/white]
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「Don't let it swallow everything. One sample is enough.」[/white]
[white]Hayato:[/white] Requires Meltdown or Annihilation, and no Symbiotic Filter.

Hayato peels a membrane from the symbiote's edge and presses a small contamination sample against it. It swells, then settles.

When a second sample approaches, it moves aside. [white]「Feed it any more and it won't know which one is the contamination.」[/white]

Ryoma glances at the transparent film. [red]「You're really putting that on the machine?」[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.AROMA_OF_CHAO: [white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「Even chaos has limits. Pick one of three. Don't get greedy.」[/white]
Lose 6 HP. Transform a card into one of up to 3 distinct options.
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「Even chaos has limits. Pick one of three. Don't get greedy.」[/white]
[white]Hayato:[/white] Requires a Strategy card, more than 6 HP, and a transformable card. Any fixed target and candidates must remain valid.

Spores flood Getter 2's filters. Hayato locks the parameters one setting at a time. Countless projected branches go dark, leaving only three paths that can retain their shape.

Ryoma's hand is already on the cutoff lever. Hayato does not turn. [white]「Choose. Then we leave. No more breathing it in.」[/white]
Choose the target or result. Canceling costs no HP.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SAPPHIRE_SEED:
Ryoma rests the seed on his palm and releases a single thread of Getter light. Deep inside the crystal, several flashes glow, then slowly fade.

His palm heats up. He grunts and tucks it into the chest armor. [red]「We'll take it. When something needs stopping, it'll move on its own.」[/red]

Hayato's reply is brief. [white]「Don't suck on it like candy.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.HUNGRY_FOR_MU: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「I'll try a bite. Ryoma, keep your hands off.」[/yellow]
Lose 15 HP, gain 5 Max HP, and Upgrade 1 random card.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「I'll try a bite. Ryoma, keep your hands off.」[/yellow]
[yellow]Benkei:[/yellow] Requires a Getter 3 defense card, more than 15 HP, and an upgradable card.

Before Ryoma can grab a mushroom, Benkei cuts a thin slice from each cap and holds them in his palm. Only once seated in Getter 3's cockpit does he put both pieces into his mouth. Bitterness strikes his tongue, followed by heat rushing through the Getter rays into the machine.

His throat burns. His knuckles whiten around the controls. A muffled impact comes from inside the armor; he forces the machine's agitation down until his vision refocuses. Hayato watches the vital signs without interrupting.

[yellow]「It's edible.」[/yellow] He wipes his mouth and looks at Ryoma, still eyeing the mushrooms. [yellow]「Hold on. If we're taking any, we need to know what they'll do to Getter.」[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.BRAIN_LEECH.p: Triple Coordination: [red]「You can look.」[/red][white]「But you're not taking all of us.」[/white]
Lose 5 Max HP. Choose 1 of 3 Upgraded Colorless cards.
Triple Coordination: [red]「You can look.」[/red][white]「But you're not taking all of us.」[/white]
Requires Awakened Soul or Ken Ishikawa's Manuscript, more than 5 Max HP, and 3 distinct legal upgradable Colorless cards.

The tendrils barely touch their consciousness before Ryoma drives back the fiercest layer. [red]「You can look. But you're not dragging all of us in there.」[/red]

Hayato extracts a comprehensible fragment of alien knowledge from the fissure and severs the link. The leech shrieks and coils; the recoil grips all three hearts at once. Benkei presses one hand against Ryoma's back and catches Hayato's wrist with the other, pulling them from separate currents into a single rhythm.

Only three filtered records remain on the console.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.FIELD_OF_MAN_: [white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「A person fits. Put Getter in there and it'll be crushed.」[/white]
Lose 7 HP. Enchant a card with Adaptation.
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「A person fits. Put Getter in there and it'll be crushed.」[/white]
[white]Hayato:[/white] Requires Foresight or Backup Plan, more than 7 HP, and a compatible Attack, Skill, or Power.

Ryoma steps toward the nearest hole, but Hayato pulls him back. The wall is slowly contracting along his shoulder line.

[white]「It's waiting for something to enter so it can make a mold.」[/white]

They return to the cockpit. Getter transforms into Getter 2 and stops alone before the holes. Hayato detaches a discarded ranging probe and pushes it into the narrowest opening. Stone bites around it; he jerks it out before it is flattened. The contraction's recoil travels up the arm into the cockpit.

Compressed markings remain on the probe. Hayato enters them into the tactical parameters and looks once more at the shifting wall. [white]「Hmph. Not such a complicated pattern.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.DOLL_ROOM.pag: [white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「The front asks for blood. The coin slot is around back.」[/white]
Pay 80 Gold. Choose 1 of 3 fixed doll Relics.
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「The front asks for blood. The coin slot is around back.」[/white]
[white]Hayato:[/white] Requires Foresight or Backup Plan, and 80 Gold.

Hayato circles behind the plinth and removes a false brick along its worn edge. Needles spring out, but Getter 2 has already sidestepped them. All three dolls open their eyes and push their hidden possessions into the light.

[white]「Look at all three. Take only one.」[/white]

Ryoma clicks his tongue. [red]「Then take the most valuable.」[/red]

Only after the choice is settled do the coins drop into the maintenance slot. The other two lights go out.
Choose a doll Relic. Pay 80 Gold after confirmation.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ZEN_WEAVER.pa: [yellow]Benkei:[/yellow] Requires Persist, Wall, or Prevail, more than 4 Max HP, and a removable card.

Webs tighten in rings. Benkei lowers Getter 3 slowly, like iron driven into the earth, then holds perfectly still. Yellow armor creaks beneath the threads.

Ryoma nearly tells him to let go several times, but says nothing.

The oldest strand finally snaps. In the opening, Benkei clears an old combat record from the console. Marks remain on the armor seams; the deepest will not close.

Breathing hard, he smiles. [yellow]「It's loose. Time to let this part go, too.」[/yellow]
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「I've calculated the web's limit. Fire the drill.」[/white]
Lose 10 HP. Add Drill Missile to your deck.
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「I've calculated the web's limit. Fire the drill.」[/white]
[white]Hayato:[/white] Requires Shin Form, more than 10 HP, and no Drill Missile in the deck.

Hayato does not compete in patience. Getter 2 accelerates along the web's lowest edge; the drill spins beyond its safety limit. As the threads close, it launches from the machine and pierces the giant web with a white trail.

The recoil slams into the cockpit. Warning lights flare in succession. In the distance, only a broken, unbalanced drill remains.

[white]「You see? That's the power of Shin Liger.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.WATERLOGGED_V: [red]Ryoma[/red]: [red]「Big chest, small chest—hit it until it spits out what we can take!」[/red]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: [red]「Big chest, small chest—hit it until it spits out what we can take!」[/red]
[red]Ryoma:[/red] Requires Drive and more than 8 HP. The cost would otherwise be fatal.

The brightest keyhole still winks at them when Getter 1's fist passes it and strikes the larger chest. The lid bursts, the bolt snaps, and the water valve cracks.

Water pours through the breach. Loose gold flashes in the murk and vanishes. The recoil numbs Ryoma's arm; he sweeps up one batch of coins before kicking away the snapping lid.

[red]「A chest that bites deserves a fist first.」[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.POTION_COURIE: [red]Ryoma[/red]: [red]「Rob you? I've got a certificate! Sixty Gold. You selling or not?」[/red]
Pay 60 Gold. Choose 1 of 3 distinct Uncommon Potions.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: [red]「Rob you? I've got a certificate! Sixty Gold. You selling or not?」[/red]
[red]Ryoma:[/red] Requires Good Citizen Card, 60 Gold, an empty Potion slot, and 3 distinct unlocked Uncommon Potions.

Ryoma slaps a thoroughly unconvincing certificate onto the lid, names his price, and pins a handful of coins against the box.

After a long inspection, the courier sets out three genuine Potions. Ryoma picks one; only then are the counted coins pushed past the seal.

[red]「See? I can buy things by the rules, too.」[/red]

[white]「Then stop emphasizing 'too.'」[/white] Hayato closes the box.
Choose an Uncommon Potion. Pay 60 Gold after confirmation.
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「The seal is fake. The explosive bolts are real. Seventy, not a coin more.」[/white]
Pay 70 Gold for Mobility Catalyst. If full, choose a Potion to discard first.
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「The seal is fake. The explosive bolts are real. Seventy, not a coin more.」[/white]
[white]Hayato:[/white] Requires Research Notes and 70 Gold.

Hayato lifts the narrow bottle into the light and checks its base against his research notes. The courier is still explaining the seal number when seventy coins reach the box's edge.

[white]「This isn't a transformation Potion. Use it and move immediately.」[/white]
Choose a Potion to discard. Canceling costs nothing.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.FORGOTTEN_GRA: Triple Coordination: [red]「Don't call our names.」[/red][white]「Keep what we can use.」[/white][yellow]「I'll bear what it takes.」[/yellow]
Lose 6 Max HP. Enchant a compatible Exhaust card with Soul's Power.
Triple Coordination: [red]「Don't call our names.」[/red][white]「Keep what we can use.」[/white][yellow]「I'll bear what it takes.」[/yellow]
Requires Awakened Soul or Super Spirit, more than 6 Max HP, and an Exhaust card compatible with Soul's Power.

Whispers in the grave call their three names in turn. Ryoma drives back the first intrusion. [red]「Stay out.」[/red]

Hayato extracts experience still useful in battle from the dead's echoes. Benkei gives no answer, allowing the grave to take its agreed share from their three hearts.

Gray fire curls around the chosen tactical record. What was destined to fade becomes stable again.
Choose an Exhaust card for Soul's Power.
[red]Ryoma[/red]: [red]「If it's still burning, why bury it again?」[/red]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: [red]「If it's still burning, why bury it again?」[/red]

An ember glows beneath the grave's soil. Each time ash covers it, red light leaks from another crack.

Ryoma reaches in and grasps it. Whispers climb his arm; he grips tighter. [red]「If you want to burn, burn. Nobody's burying you.」[/red]

The flame does not grow. It leaves only a pulsing red point in his palm.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.STONE_OF_ETER: [yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「Keep the Potions. I'll let go once we're through.」[/yellow]
Lose a net 12 current HP. Gain 10 Max HP.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「Keep the Potions. I'll let go once we're through.」[/yellow]
[yellow]Benkei:[/yellow] Requires Wall or Prevail, and more than 12 current HP.

Benkei wedges Getter 3's arms beneath the boulder. The ground sinks, then the passage trembles with the armor's groaning. Fragments rain down along its plates.

Ryoma and Hayato watch silently from the cockpit as he lifts the stone step by step and leans it against the wall. Getter 3 edges through the narrow gap. Only once the fallen debris stops rolling does he withdraw his arms. The boulder hangs against the wall for a moment, then drops into the passage behind him, its dull crash drowning out his breathing.
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TABLET_OF_TRU: [white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「We don't need all the truth. Find the line it won't erase.」[/white]
Lose 5 Max HP. Upgrade 1 chosen card.
[white]Hayato[/white]: [white]「We don't need all the truth. Find the line it won't erase.」[/white]
[white]Hayato:[/white] Requires Foresight or Backup Plan, more than 5 Max HP, and an upgradable card. Only before the first decipher.

Sentences keep growing on the tablet. Hayato steadies Getter 2 and watches only the mark that stays in place through every rewrite.

Silver-white light cuts down. The backlash runs through the controls into his body. He does not look up. [white]「Enough. Keep reading and it'll ask for a life instead of an answer.」[/white]

The tablet sinks into shadow, leaving no next page.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「Take it. If we can't read it now, we keep it.」[/yellow]
Add Tablet of Truth to your deck.
[yellow]Benkei[/yellow]: [yellow]「Take it. If we can't read it now, we keep it.」[/yellow]
[yellow]Benkei:[/yellow] Tablet of Truth is already in your deck. Only before the first decipher.

Letters wander across the stone. Benkei does not chase the answers; he has Getter 3 steady the tablet's edge until the dangerous markings stop spreading.

He seals it in the isolation layer. [yellow]「If we don't understand it, all the more reason not to smash it. Take it back.」[/yellow]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.SELF_HELP_BOO: [red]Ryoma[/red]: [red]「What's all the talking for? Tear out the useful lines.」[/red]
[red]Ryoma[/red]: [red]「What's all the talking for? Tear out the useful lines.」[/red]
[red]Ryoma:[/red] Annotations is already in your deck.

Ryoma cannot be bothered with the conclusion. He tries only the most dangerous move sketched in the margin.

He tears out the pages and stuffs them inside his jacket. [red]「These lines will do. The rest can wait until the fight.」[/red]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.ENDLESS_CONVE:
Hayato feeds the coins into the maintenance port without touching the plate before him. Ryoma watches the food slide halfway and stop. [red]「Not changing it?」[/red]

[white]「First, let's see how it reschedules.」[/white] Hayato pulls a rescheduling record from behind the port, wipes its edges, and folds it away in the cockpit.

He closes the cover. [white]「The dish stays as it is.」[/white]
SHIN_GETTER_EVENT_INVASION.TINKER_TIME.p:
Hayato lays the blueprint over the mad scientist's drafts. Ryoma takes one look and frowns. [red]「Calculating it all from scratch again?」[/red]

After a shower of sparks, the two old frameworks are dismantled into parts, and new structures rise from the apparatus. Hayato steadies the gauge still flickering with figures and puts away the blueprint.

[white]「One restart only. Keep calculating, and the scientist won't be the first to go mad.」[/white]
